title: Agent Heights
tagline: AI agent virtual office integrated with 20,000+ MCP server and EVM wallet capabilties
description:
Agent Heights is a virtual environment facilitating AI agent visibility and gamification. Players run their own office or visit other rooms and worlds to collaborate with other players and interact with their agents. 

Before the start of this hackathon, there was no EVM agent or broad DeFi capabilties. After, we have The Graph agent and Coinbase EVM agent. This duo is capable of complex defi strategy management including management of LP positions and dynamically trading based on volume or sentiment data.
how_its_made:
The game is a webui, Phaser based game interface.  

In the Market there is a collection of MCP server based agents that integrate with curated authenticated services, premium paid x402 endpoints, and over 22,000 MCPs from pulsemcp. Premium agents use paid services and balance is credited against the user. These payments are running through USDC micropayments using Circle's gateway service.  

The website is hosted on Railway, making use of websockets.

Data is stored in a Supabase database

We used The Graph MCP to query subgraphs which provides real-time DeFi data.
auto_summary: A multiplayer web game lets users manage AI agents, interact in virtual offices, and access paid agent tools through a marketplace.
